wordmark.purpose: Top bar wordmark and Settings title.

quote.purpose: Message text in the confirmation quote.

body.purpose: Task detail, spoken instructions, replies, errors.

status.purpose: Live task state line, colored by state.

label.purpose: Section labels and the Tandem reply label.

detail.purpose: Row details, quote meta, field labels.

caption.purpose: Line under the main button and the about line.

motion.name: none
motion.purpose: No continuous or decorative animation. State changes are instant color swaps on press and focus.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one full-width action at the bottom of Home. Start talking, or Pair this phone when unpaired.

narrative.overview:
Tandem is a near-black, dark-only Android app in the Boson AI design system. Each screen is a quiet canvas with one large question or headline, and every control sits at the bottom near the thumb. Green is rare and means one of two things: the action to take, or a session that is live.

The mark tells the story. A white dot is you. A signal-green arc beside it is Tandem, listening and answering. The source of truth is `mobile/App.tsx`. The Paper design file is the "Tandem app" page in "Boson AI Design System" (https://app.paper.design/file/01M5B4ADQSXTWS4JWY87EBYE4C/p-5-0).

Rendered evidence in `.impeccable/review/`: home while unpaired (`tandem-emulator-5554.png`), Settings (`tandem-settings.png`), and home at 1.3x font scale (`tandem-large.png`). The Live, Working and Confirm states exist in code but were not captured on a device, because no server was available.
keyCharacteristics: Bottom-weighted screens. Content sits low, actions sit lowest.
Green only for the primary action and a live session.
Information sits directly on the canvas. The message quote is the only enclosed block.
No shadows, gradients, section rules, or continuous animation.

rules.name: The Two Greens Rule
rules.body: Signal green marks the primary action and a live session. Stop is neutral (raised), never green or red. Anything structural that wants green uses sage.

rules.name: The Scale With The User Rule
rules.body: Text follows Android font scale. At 1.3x the home screen still fits, the question wraps and the bottom stack stays intact.

rules.name: The Thumb Rule
rules.body: The main area grows and the content falls to the bottom. Never pin content to the top and leave the bottom empty.

rules.name: The Open Canvas Rule
rules.body: Information sits directly on the canvas. The message quote is the only enclosed block, because it shows words Tandem is about to send for you.

dos: Do keep one full-width primary action per screen, at the bottom.
Do use sage for structure and signal green for action or live state.
Do ask for confirmation by voice, with a spoken yes/no instruction under the quote.
Do keep touch targets at 48 or more.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, cards, pills, or rules between sections.
Don't add pulsing, shimmering, or spinning animation, including on the live dot.
Don't add confirm buttons to the Confirm state.
Don't use green for decoration or for neutral information.
Don't treat the idle screenshots as proof that Live or Confirm render correctly on device.
